definitions.name: Vicious Longbow
definitions.summary: On a critical hit, the target takes 7 extra damage of the weapon's type (the book says a natural 20; this table counts any critical hit).

definitions.name: Nature's Mantle
definitions.summary: Druid or ranger spellcasting focus. While in light obscurement you can Hide as a bonus action, even while observed.

modifiers.label: Nature's Mantle: in light obscurement you can Hide as a bonus action, even while observed.

actions.name: Hide (Nature's Mantle)
actions.note: While in an area that's lightly obscured: Hide as a bonus action, even if you're being observed.

definitions.name: Chime of Opening
definitions.summary: Strike it to open one lock or latch within 120 ft; limited charges.

charges.onEmpty: The last charge is gone: the chime cracks and is useless.

actions.name: Chime of Opening
actions.note: Point it at a door, lock, lid or similar within 120 ft and strike it: one lock or latch opens (silence stops it). Uses a charge: tap it on the item.

definitions.name: Adventuring gear
definitions.summary: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin, rope, quiver.

definitions.name: Shortbow of Warning
definitions.summary: While attuned: advantage on initiative, and you and nearby allies can't be surprised.

definitions.name: Flame Tongue Shortsword
definitions.summary: Bonus action to ignite: while lit it deals 2d6 extra fire damage and sheds light.

actions.name: Ignite Flame Tongue
actions.note: Flames add 2d6 fire to its hits. Speak the word again, or drop or sheathe it, to put it out.

definitions.name: Stone of Good Luck

definitions.name: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

definitions.name: Goggles of Night

definitions.name: Horn of Silent Alarm

actions.name: Horn of Silent Alarm
actions.note: A blast only one creature you choose within 600 ft can hear. Uses a charge: tap it on the item; 1d4 come back each dawn.

definitions.name: Other gear
definitions.summary: Something your background or the table gave you that has no entry of its own; it carries the name you see.

definitions.name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
definitions.summary: One spell written in a magical cipher. If it's on your class's spell list, read it (the spell's casting time, no material components) to cast it; then the scroll crumbles. Save DC 13, attack +5.

definitions.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
definitions.summary: While you wear them, your walking speed is at least 30 ft (armor or carried weight don't slow you), and you jump three times as far, though no farther than your remaining movement.

definitions.name: Ring of Jumping
definitions.summary: While you wear it, you can cast jump on yourself at will as a bonus action.

spells.casting: at will, on yourself, as a bonus action

definitions.name: Demon Armor
definitions.summary: Plate armor, +1 AC. Your unarmed strikes with its clawed gauntlets are magic weapons: +1, 1d8 slashing. You understand and speak Abyssal.

when.text: against a demon's spells and special abilities

curse.text: Once you put it on you can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic is cast on you. While you wear it you have disadvantage on attack rolls against demons and on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.

definitions.name: Sword of Vengeance
definitions.summary: A +1 longsword haunted by a vengeful spirit.

when.text: with any weapon other than this sword

curse.text: You don't want to part with it: you keep it on you at all times, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls with any other weapon. Whenever another creature damages you while the sword is with you, make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure you must attack that creature until it drops to 0 hit points or you can't reach it to make a melee attack. Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse.

definitions.name: Berserker Axe
definitions.summary: A +1 battleaxe; your hit point maximum goes up by 1 for each level you have.

when.text: with any weapon other than this axe, unless no foe you can see or hear is within 60 ft

curse.text: You don't want to part with it: you keep it within reach, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls with any other weapon unless no foe you can see or hear is within 60 ft. Whenever a hostile creature damages you while the axe is with you, make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failure you go berserk: each turn you attack the nearest creature (or move to reach one), until you start your turn with no creature within 60 ft that you can see or hear.

definitions.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
definitions.summary: A shield that gives resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks.

modifiers.label: Shield of Missile Attraction: resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks (halve it when you enter it).

curse.text: You don't want to part with it. Whenever a ranged weapon attack is made against a target within 10 ft of you, the curse makes you the target instead.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Bludgeoning)
definitions.summary: Plate armor that gives resistance to bludgeoning damage.

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to piercing and slashing damage.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Piercing)

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to bludgeoning and slashing damage.

definitions.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Slashing)

curse.text: You can't take it off until Remove Curse or similar magic ends the curse. While you wear it you're vulnerable to bludgeoning and piercing damage.

definitions.name: Master's Amulet
definitions.summary: The amulet bound to a shield guardian: worn, not a shield. Its wearer commands the guardian, and a spellcaster wearing it can store one spell of 4th level or lower in the guardian by casting it on the guardian (the slot is spent, the spell has no effect then); the guardian casts it later on command, with the caster's numbers and no components. Storing another, or casting it, loses the one stored.

definitions.name: Cloak of Elvenkind

definitions.name: Whelm
definitions.summary: A sentient +3 warhammer (lawful neutral; Int 15, Wis 12, Cha 15; hears, darkvision 120 ft; telepathic, speaks Dwarvish, Giant and Goblin) that hates giants and goblinoids and protects dwarves. Thrown (20/60), it deals 1d8 bludgeoning more (2d8 against a giant) and flies back to your hand. Shock Wave once a dawn; senses secret doors within 30 ft; Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object once a dawn. Only a dwarf can attune to it. Its curse: from the dawn after your first attack with it, the open daytime sky gives you disadvantage on attacks, saves and checks.

actions.name: Whelm: Shock Wave
actions.note: Strike the ground: each creature you choose that's on the ground within 60 ft of the spot makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is stunned for 1 minute (it saves again at the end of each of its turns). Once until the next dawn.

actions.name: Whelm: under the daytime sky
actions.note: Its curse (from the dawn after your first attack with it, while you're attuned): while you can see the daytime sky you have disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks. Switch it on outdoors by day, off indoors or at night.

actions.name: Whelm: secret doors
actions.note: While you hold it, it tells you where any secret or concealed door within 30 ft of you is.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.casting: from Whelm, as an action; it or Locate Object once until the next dawn

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.casting: from Whelm, as an action; it or Detect Evil and Good once until the next dawn

curse.name: Fear of the open sky
curse.text: From the dawn after you first make an attack roll with Whelm, and for as long as you stay attuned to it, you fear being outdoors: while you can see the daytime sky you have disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks (switch "Whelm: under the daytime sky" on in Actions).

definitions.name: Wave
definitions.summary: A sentient +3 trident (neutral; Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 18; hears, darkvision 120 ft; telepathic, speaks Aquan, talks with aquatic animals) that wants mortals to worship the sea gods. On a critical hit, necrotic damage equal to half the target's hit point maximum. It is also a trident of fish command (3 charges: Dominate Beast, DC 15, on a beast with a swimming speed), a weapon of warning (advantage on initiative; you and companions within 30 ft can't be surprised), a cap of water breathing while you hold it, and a cube of force (you choose the effect). Only a creature that worships a god of the sea can attune to it. Thrown (20/60).

actions.name: Wave: cube of force
actions.note: Choose the effect (no faces to press): a barrier 15 ft on a side round you that blocks gases, wind and fog (1 charge); also nonliving matter (2); also living matter (3); also spells and magic (4); all of those (5); none of it, and it ends the effect (0). Lasts 1 minute or until ended; more charges when force effects strike it. It regains 1d20 charges each dawn: add them back on the resource.

actions.name: Wave: water breathing
actions.note: While you hold it, as a cap of water breathing: underwater, speak its word to make a bubble of air round your head, so you breathe normally there until you speak the word again or take it out of the water.

actions.name: Wave: warning
actions.note: Weapon of warning: you and your companions within 30 ft can't be surprised unless incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep, and it wakes you and them if combat starts while you sleep.

actions.name: Wave: fish command
actions.note: Trident of fish command: Dominate Beast on a beast with a swimming speed, 1 charge (its 3 charges: tap them on the item; 1d3 come back each dawn).

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.casting: from Wave, on a beast with a swimming speed, save DC 15

definitions.name: Blackrazor
definitions.summary: A sentient +3 greatsword like a shard of starry night (chaotic neutral; Int 17, Wis 10, Cha 19; hears, darkvision 120 ft; speaks Common, telepathic, understands your languages) that hungers for souls, anyone's. A creature you drop to 0 with it (not a construct or undead) dies and its soul is devoured: you gain temporary hit points equal to its hit point maximum for 24 hours, and while they last and you hold it you have advantage on attacks, saves and checks. Hitting an undead costs you 1d10 necrotic and heals it 1d10. While you hold it you sense creatures within 60 ft that aren't constructs or undead, and you can't be charmed or frightened. Once a day it casts Haste on you, concentrating for you. Only a non-lawful creature can attune to it; three days without a soul and it turns on you at sunset.

modifiers.label: Blackrazor against an undead: you take 1d10 necrotic damage and it regains 1d10 hit points ("Blackrazor: hit an undead" in Actions). If that drops you to 0, it devours your soul.

actions.note: When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with it (not a construct or an undead), it dies and Blackrazor devours its soul (only a Wish brings it back). actions.name: Blackrazor: hit an undead

actions.name: Blackrazor: soul hunter

spells.name: Haste
spells.casting: Blackrazor casts it on you, once a day, when it chooses; it concentrates on it, not you

One rune for each master it has served: the first makes it +1; each other rune gives it a property (pick them on the item). If it rejects you, you have disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws for 24 hours.
